name: Amidorphin
summary: Amidorphin is an endogenous, C-terminally amidated, opioid peptide generated as a cleavage product of proenkephalin A in some mammalian species; in humans and most other species, the peptide is 1 residue longer and is not amidated. Amidorphin is widely distributed in the mammalian brain, with particularly high concentrations found in the striatum, and outside of the brain in adrenal medulla and posterior pituitary.

pharmacology.en: It is a peptide that acts on opioid receptors, the same targets as morphine and the body's other natural opioids. Its exact role in the body is still not well understood.
pharmacology.zh: 它是一種作用於鴉片受體的胜肽，這些受體也是嗎啡與體內其他天然鴉片物質的標的。它在體內的確切角色至今仍不清楚。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是一种作用于鸦片受体的胜肽，这些受体也是吗啡与体内其他天然鸦片物质的标的。它在体内的确切角色至今仍不清楚。

uses.en: It is not a medicine. It is studied in the laboratory to understand the body's own opioid system.
uses.zh: 它不是藥物，而是實驗室研究的對象，用來了解身體自身的鴉片系統。
uses.zhHans: 它不是药物，而是实验室研究的对象，用来了解身体自身的鸦片系统。

fact.en: It is cut from proenkephalin A, the same precursor protein that gives the enkephalins. In humans the peptide is one amino acid longer and is not capped with an amide group, unlike in some other mammals.
fact.zh: 它切自 proenkephalin A，也就是產生腦磷肽的同一個前驅蛋白。在人類身上，這個胜肽多一個胺基酸，而且末端沒有像某些其他哺乳類那樣接上醯胺基。
fact.zhHans: 它切自 proenkephalin A，也就是产生脑磷肽的同一个前驱蛋白。在人类身上，这个胜肽多一个胺基酸，而且末端没有像某些其他哺乳类那样接上酰胺基。
